purpose: Compass for agents: nodes are goals, issues, facts, questions, decisions and actions; hyperedges say what must hold before a node can move. A node with probe=null still needs a probe. Update a node's state only with a probe result or a merged change as evidence.

semantics.hyperedge: requires (set of node ids) enables (node id); mode all = every prerequisite, any = at least one
semantics.probe: read-only argv that observes the fact; null means no probe yet
